scripture.text: Using a dull axe requires great strength, so sharpen the blade.

slides.headline: Read that again.
body: Most of us respond to a hard season by swinging harder.

slides.headline: Solomon's answer is not effort. It is edge.
body: And the verse tells you what the edge is made of.
"That is the value of wisdom. It helps you succeed."

slides.headline: Wisdom is leverage.
body: It is the difference between working hard and working sharp.
slides.kicker: Same tree. Same arms. Different blade.

slides.eyebrow: SO WHERE DOES EDGE COME FROM?
body: Hebrews says there is milk, and there is meat.
Milk keeps you alive. Meat makes you strong.

slides.headline: Stop relaying the foundation.
body: Repentance. Faith. Baptisms. Laying on of hands. Resurrection. Judgement.
Learn them properly. Then move on.

slides.headline: Years of attendance is not the same as years of understanding.
body: You can hear something two hundred times and still not be able to explain it once.

slides.headline: Name one thing you believe but could not explain to a twelve year old.
body: That is what sharpening looks like.

slides.headline: God is not asking you for more strength.
slides.kicker: He is offering you a sharper blade.
